clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs add response-settling logic to close() for parked JSON-response-mode POSTs, touching the same code path in streamableHttp.ts. #2600 is the superset fix: beyond settling the parked response, it also clears _requestToStreamMapping on close and makes send() re-check the correlation after the eventStore.storeEvent() await, closing a separate resource leak (a response recorded against a retired correlation that can never be delivered) that #2692 does not address. #2600's parked-POST response also reuses the transport's existing 404 'Session not found' error path already returned by validateSession() elsewhere in the file, keeping error handling consistent, whereas #2692 introduces a new -32000 'Connection closed' JSON-RPC error shape not used anywhere else in the transport.
